carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features are visible along the posterior flank and caudal peduncle, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high-luminance superior edges and shadowed inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin displays highly distinct patterning: the upper lobe features prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity, while the lower lobe exhibits a linear sequence of high-luminance circular blobs along its leading edge.
